episodes.synopsis: While bathing in the public bathhouse his grandfather designed and built, a boy in ancient Rome is momentarily transported to a very strange place.
episodes.title: All Baths Lead to Rome

episodes.synopsis: Rome, 128 A.D. In a golden age of bathhouse innovation, bathhouse architect Lucius tries to come up with fresh ideas that will set his designs apart.
episodes.title: The Thermae Architect Who Leapt Through Time

episodes.synopsis: After Consul Lepidus asks him to build an outdoor bath with a view of Mt. Vesuvius, Lucius suddenly finds himself bathing among strange-looking monkeys.
episodes.title: Lucius Builds an Outdoor Bath

episodes.synopsis: Lucius ends up in a small bathroom in a modern Japanese house and is completely fascinated by everything he finds.
episodes.title: Lucius Builds an Indoor Bath

episodes.synopsis: Impressed by his creativity, Emperor Hadrian invites Lucius to his opulent villa and asks him to build a private bath.
episodes.title: Lucius Builds a Bath in Emperor Hadrian's Villa

episodes.synopsis: Lucius works to complete a bathing area for soldiers fighting on the front lines — and not a minute too soon, as the men are in dire need of healing.
episodes.title: Lucius Builds a Hot Stone Spa

episodes.synopsis: While stopping in an unwelcoming tavern during his long journey home, Lucius surfaces in a comfortable Edo-era rest stop along the Tokaido road.
episodes.title: Lucius Appears on the Tokaido Road in the Edo Period

episodes.synopsis: Lucius encounters a set of very rude bathers who don't seem to know the first thing about proper bathhouse etiquette.
episodes.title: Lucius Learns Bathing Etiquette in Japan

episodes.synopsis: On a construction site for a Roman-style spa in modern day Japan, Lucius meets a fellow bathhouse architect.
episodes.title: Lucius Meets a Fellow Architect in Japan

episodes.synopsis: Emperor Hadrian asks Lucius to devote himself to building a large public bathhouse in the name of his son and heir to the Empire.
episodes.title: Lucius Builds a Theme Bath

episodes.synopsis: To undermine public support for the Emperor, some members of the Senate scheme to get rid of the man behind the popular bathhouses: Lucius.
episodes.title: Lucius Builds a Spa Town
